svg.text: A VM Nebula Product | High-level, non-sensitive descriptions for partner/fellowship materials.
Unified analytics across LLM providers. Recommends lower-cost model choices and routing.
Benefits: lower spend, latency controls, provider-agnostic insights.
Short-term and monthly forecasts using cloud ML. Helps finance teams budget and prevent overages.
Benefits: proactive alerts, budget planning, scenario analysis.
Maps AI costs to customers and features (finance-grade), enabling chargeback and ROI analysis.
Benefits: unit economics, profitability per feature, CFO-ready reports.

This asset purposefully omits implementation specifics (exact model weights, heuristics, SQL, and routing rules). It conveys product value, integrations, and outcomes without exposing proprietary code.
Recommended use: submission materials, slide decks, partner briefings.
